Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government digital identity systems and credentials. 30 variables in 5 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether the ongoing management, maintenance and development of the ID system can be funded by sustainable domestic resources
Comments: Seychelles is an upper-middle income country with a strong domestic economy (tourism-based). The government funds the DICT and SeyID platform through the national budget, with R145.1 million allocated in 2023 for ICT projects per the Finance Minister's budget speech. While WISeKey was contracted for platform development, operational costs are budgeted domestically. The World Bank's PforR social protection program is separately funded but the core ID system is domestically financed. No evidence of external donor dependency for the ID system.
